feeds.title: OnePeterFive
feeds.description: OnePeterFive exists as a place to begin rebuilding the Catholic ethos. The writers come from diverse backgrounds, but share a common goal: to work together to restore the beauty, majesty, and glory of the Catholic Church as the principal force for good in a fallen world.

feeds.title: Liturgy Guy
feeds.description: My name is Brian Williams. I call myself the Liturgy Guy because I never grow tired of reading, writing, or speaking to people about the liturgy of the Catholic Church. It is my hope that you are both informed and entertained by 'Life, Liturgy and the Pursuit of Holiness.'

feeds.title: Association Of Catholic Priests Blog
feeds.description: The ACP blog offers insightful updates as well as incisive knowledge about Catholic culture. We are an association for Catholic Priests who wish to have a forum, and a voice to reflect, discuss and comment on issues affecting the Irish Church and society today.

feeds.title: The Prodigal Catholic
feeds.description: The Prodigal Catholic is a collection of writings about the attributes and moral principles of being a catholic man as well as the obligations that must be fulfilled throughout one's lifetime.

feeds.title: The Simple Catholic Blog
feeds.description: I began The Simple Catholic blog in 2015 with the hope of drawing others closer to understanding the splendor of truth as taught by Jesus Christ and safeguarded by the Catholic Church. I hope to use my writing as a means of growing in holiness and bringing others to Christ as well.

feeds.title: The Catholic Gentleman Blog
feeds.description: A blog for Catholic men that seeks to encourage virtue, the pursuit of holiness and the art of true masculinity.

feeds.title: The Catholic Man Reviews
feeds.description: The Catholic Man Reviews is a Catholic Products Review blog which is moderated by Vincent Pham. This blog was created to promote the reading of Catholic books and the use of Catholic materials in everyday life. He reviews Catholic materials such as books, media, films and services that will be of help for Catholics.

feeds.title: The King's Men Blog
feeds.description: The King's Men is a Roman Catholic lay apostolate faithfully executing on its mission to help men across the country and around the world be better husbands, fathers and leaders.

feeds.title: Catholic Men's Fellowship of California Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Men's Fellowship is a lay ministry, fully approved by the Church, that since 1991 has been reaching out to all Catholic men to encourage them to strengthen their faith in Christ and to become better sons, brothers husbands, fathers and friends.

feeds.title: Catholic Voices Blog
feeds.description: Through the blogs, we provide all the regular updates happening In the industry. Catholic Voices is a project which began in the UK to improve the Church's representation in the media, above all in news programs and debates.

feeds.title: Lionheart Catholic Blog
feeds.description: The content on the Lionheart Catholic Blog is mostly devoted to the spiritual and practical facets of Catholic men and Catholic culture. Hi, I'm Devin Rose a Catholic husband and father, a convert to the Faith from atheism by way of Evangelical Protestantism.

feeds.title: 94.9 St Michael Catholic Radio Blog
feeds.description: The St. Michael Catholic Radio blog attempts to reawaken your spiritual side as a Catholic by sprinkling you with Catholic values and ideals. The goal of the website is to educate interested Catholic males about the spiritual side.

feeds.title: Catholic Men For Jesus Christ Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Men for Jesus Christ strives to bring men together to build each other up, support one another, and challenge one another on our spiritual journeys to become the men that we are created and called to be.

feeds.title: Roman Catholic Man
feeds.description: Roman Catholic Man is a website with everything needed to inspire and train men who seek the Lord with all their hearts, mind, soul, and strength. This is a site for Roman Catholic Men by Roman Catholic Men.
